0022600161.text: The New York Knicks (2-4, 11th in the East) host the Brooklyn Nets (1-5, 15th in the East), with New York coming off a loss while Brooklyn has won its most recent game. Jose Alvarado is out for the Knicks with an ankle sprain, while the Nets are without Egor Demin (leg bruise), Mikel Brown Jr. (rest) and Tyler Bilodeau (shoulder sprain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Knicks won the four meetings in 2025-26, most recently a 93-92 win in Brooklyn on March 20, 2026.
